title: Canada Women's Rugby Team Aims to Break England's Winning Streak
summary: Canada's women's rugby team is preparing to face England with the goal of ending England's impressive 39-match winning streak. The match is set to take place in Toronto.
summary_points: Canada's women's rugby team will play against England.
The objective is to end England's 39-game winning streak.
The match is scheduled to be held in Toronto.
